Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Chief General Manager, Field Gun Factory, Kanpur
